_purpose: Test pure diplomat archetype (Charm 6, Persuasion 5, Debt Law 5, Insight 5), zero-combat resolution, multi-faction negotiation, social clocks, reputation mechanics, failure state = war outbreak
_comment_vendors: === VENDOR SYSTEM - DISABLED (Seed Trade is Plot, Not Vendors) ===
_scenario_hint: Neutral Zone Trade Station (void_level 3, demilitarized) - Summit to resolve Seed harvesting rights dispute between ACG (wants monopoly), Resonance Communes (spiritual claim), and Freeborn Collective (labor rights). Each faction has valid grievances and leverage. Players must: broker compromise, manage escalating tensions, prevent walkout/violence. NPCs: ACG hardliner (greedy), Commune elder (principled), Freeborn agitator (angry). Failure modes: summit collapses → trade war, violence erupts → players blamed, one faction dominates → moral compromise. Success: balanced treaty all sides accept.

_design_notes.ml_training_value: Pure social/negotiation scenario, zero combat resolution, tests Charm/Persuasion/Insight/Debt Law in high-stakes context, multi-faction relationship management, dynamic NPC attitudes, reputation tracking, moral trade-offs in diplomacy, failure = systemic consequences (not death)
_design_notes.character_innovation: First config with Charm 6 + Persuasion 5 primary, pure social focus, no combat skills, recording drones for evidence gathering, soulcredit scanners for leverage discovery

starting_clocks.name: Summit Tension
starting_clocks.description: Overall conflict escalation. At 7 ticks: faction walkout threatened. At 10 ticks: summit collapses, trade war begins.

starting_clocks.name: ACG Trust
starting_clocks.description: ACG faction confidence in mediators. At 0: ACG walks out. At 6: ACG makes major concession.

starting_clocks.name: Commune Trust
starting_clocks.description: Resonance Communes confidence in mediators. At 0: Commune walks out. At 6: Commune makes major concession.

starting_clocks.name: Freeborn Trust
starting_clocks.description: Freeborn Collective confidence in mediators. At 0: Freeborn walks out. At 6: Freeborn makes major concession.

starting_clocks.name: Treaty Progress
starting_clocks.description: Agreement framework development. At 8 ticks: comprehensive treaty ready for signing (if all factions still at table).

players.name: Mediator Lyris Venn
goals: Broker treaty that prevents trade war and protects ACG interests
Maintain neutrality appearance while advancing ACG position
Build personal reputation as master negotiator

players.name: Harmonizer Sael
goals: Ensure spiritual sanctity of Seed harvesting is respected
Find compromise that honors all parties' humanity

players.name: Advocate Thren Koss
goals: Secure fair wages and safety protections for Freeborn workers
Expose ACG exploitation and Nexus complicity
Prevent treaty that perpetuates corporate dominance

notes: ML Training Focus: Pure diplomat archetype (Charm 6, Persuasion 5-6, Counsel 6, Insight 6), ZERO combat scenario - failure is social collapse not death. Multi-faction negotiation with 5 social clocks tracking trust/tension. Tests underrepresented social skills in high-stakes context, NPC attitude management, compromise crafting, moral trade-offs in diplomacy. Long campaign (20 turns) allows for relationship building, trust erosion, leverage discovery, and dynamic NPC reactions. Features no combat weapons - all fists/unarmed. Success requires balancing competing interests without force.
